acceptance.target: native Mac ARM64 for current development

contracts.name: Source state and input ownership
requires: Distinct bytes/need-input/byte-range/finished/transport-failure/invalid/limit/cancel outcomes
Optional source length and explicit sequential/range capabilities; no whole-file buffering to simulate seeking
Bounded work before yielding; cancellation reaches blocked acquisition through the consumer adapter
Exact-sized end may be parked; failed non-end reopen remains transport failure
contracts.status: draft semantic requirement; not implemented or qualified by this lane

contracts.name: Source packet facts
requires: Stable track identity, immutable payload and exact configuration
Separate optional signed PTS and DTS; exact duration/trim/timebase/provenance
Preserve source packet/decode order; adapter display fallbacks are separately observable
Preserve typed and opaque side data, random-access, corruption and discard facts
contracts.ready: semantic fixture SEM03 and source call inventory
contracts.status: draft semantic requirement; not implemented or qualified by this lane

contracts.name: Retained memory and backpressure
requires: Charge retained backing capacity once while any output owner retains it
Separately charge queue descriptors, metadata, indexes, reference frames, conversion scratch and device transfers
Fallible checked reservations, byte/work/output caps and explicit backpressure
Lower equivalent live heap and attributable high-water RSS; dropping outputs is not a memory improvement
contracts.blocked_on: parent-frozen budget/ownership API and decoder-specific bounds
contracts.status: draft semantic requirement; not implemented or qualified by this lane

contracts.name: Seek/reset generation isolation
requires: Fresh generation for seek/backend replacement/configuration transactions
Discard stale outputs without relabelling them as the new timeline
Explicit preroll/discard-until and EOF-drain versus flush/stop behavior
Consumer retains clocks, scheduling and transport policy
contracts.blocked_on: parent-frozen transaction/seek lifecycle plus chosen decoder adapter
contracts.status: draft semantic requirement; not implemented or qualified by this lane

contracts.name: Subtitle metadata and output

Bitmap clear/set events, authoring canvas, all required rectangles, palette/alpha and timing

Explicit packet/output association, configuration changes, reorder, delay and EOF drain
Consumer OS adapter remains outside pure-safe core; selection does not admit dependencies
